reflection: Round 1: no notebook yet. I will propose a mix of mean-reversion, volatility-regime, and cross-asset lead factors, using the stage-1 hint that volatility and MSFT/NVDA moves matter. Improve/partner slots have no real parents, so I base them on the most useful existing factors.

factors.name: aapl_vol_ratio_5_20
factors.hypothesis: Volatility_10d is the most useful existing factor; the ratio of short to long-term vol captures the regime shift (vol spike vs normal) across years with different vol levels, making it more stationary.

factors.name: msft_ret_zscore_20
factors.hypothesis: MSFT 1d return matters but its scale varies by year; standardizing by recent vol makes the signal comparable across regimes.

factors.name: aapl_close_position_range
factors.hypothesis: Where the close sits in the day's range captures intraday buying/selling pressure that may carry over or mean-revert.

factors.name: aapl_overnight_gap
factors.hypothesis: The overnight gap reflects news absorbed outside trading hours and may show reversal or continuation the next day.

factors.name: qqq_vol_ratio_5_20
factors.hypothesis: Market-wide vol expansion complements Apple's own vol: Apple vol alone mixes idiosyncratic and market stress, this separates the market regime.

factors.name: aapl_rel_qqq_5d_zscore
factors.hypothesis: Apple's multi-day relative strength vs QQQ, standardized, complements QQQ trend: stretched underperformance/outperformance may mean-revert toward the market.
